title: Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future On November 10, 2026, President Nayib Bukele hosted roughly 30 Bitcoiners at Casa Presidencial during Bitcoin Histórico. Guests included Ricardo Salinas Pliego, Parker Lewis, Mike Peterson, and miners; discussions covered power generation for compute and immigration. This post Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .
